summary: An empty Zoox robotaxi drove into a smoke-covered emergency fire scene in Las Vegas, braked hard and stopped, then was reversed remotely. Zoox recalled its 105-vehicle fleet for a software update to detect heavy smoke better.

A remote operator reversed the vehicle. The recall delivered a software update improving detection of and response to heavy smoke.
